# GigOra

> Milestone-Based Tech Marketplace connecting founders and clients with Indian software developers, designers, and tech talent.

## Overview
GigOra is a technical talent marketplace designed around clear milestone-based workflows, transparent project deliverables, real-time client-freelancer collaboration, and escrow-style payment safety.

- **Founder & Developer:** Vipin Gupta (BSc Computer Science, Mumbai)
- **Status:** Working Production Prototype & Preview (Live on https://gig-ora.vercel.app)
- **Tech Stack:** React 19, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Socket.io, JWT Authentication.

## Core Features
1. **Milestone-Based Escrow Workflow:** Projects are broken down into measurable milestones. Clients fund milestones into escrow before work begins, and funds are released upon review and approval.
2. **Transparent Tech Talent Discovery:** Filter and discover developers and designers specializing in React, Node.js, Python, Full-Stack, AI/ML, DevOps, and UI/UX.
3. **Real-Time Collaboration:** In-platform workspace with live chat, file attachments, and activity feeds powered by WebSockets.
4. **Honest Preview Mode:** Clearly marked preview environment running demo payment settlement mode for portfolio review and functional demonstration.
